conditions.with-skill: the skill is available and named in the request
conditions.control: benchmark/control.md loaded in place of the skill: generic advice of about the same length

order: Run without-skill first and drop any task it already passes on every run; a task at the ceiling cannot show a difference.
models: at least two; record the exact model ids in each result
record: benchmark/results/<date>.json: per condition and model, the pass rate of every case check, cost, and time
